content: {"praised":["Ecstasies of Women is the best of the collection","The films are a valuable slice of 1970s exploitation history","Vinegar Syndrome’s release offers clear, crisp negative transfers","The set includes three rare, long‑lost sex‑exploitation flicks","Herschell Gordon Lewis’s work is celebrated as a genre pioneer"],"criticized":["The material feels dated and unpolished","Dialog quality is weak and suffers from poor scripting","Some films appear cut or edited out","The collection does not truly contain all lost footage","Overall pacing and storytelling are uneven"]}
